content: While you are taking this medication, it is essential to attend all scheduled medical and laboratory appointments. Pinworm infections are highly contagious and can easily spread to others. To prevent reinfection, practice strict hygiene measures. Wash your hands frequently, especially after using the bathroom, and disinfect toilets daily. If you miss a dose and are taking more than one dose, take the missed dose as soon as you remember. However, if it is close to the time of your next scheduled dose, skip the missed dose and resume your regular dosing schedule. Do not double the dose to catch up. Store this medication at room temperature, away from light and moisture. Do not store it in the bathroom. Do not flush medications down the toilet or pour them into a drain unless specifically instructed to do so. Properly discard this product when it is expired or no longer needed. This information is a summary and does not include all possible details about this product. It does not guarantee that the product is safe, effective, or appropriate for you. It is not a substitute for individualized medical advice. Always consult your healthcare professional for complete information about this medication and your specific health needs. Before starting this medication, read the patient information leaflet provided by your pharmacist. Take this medication orally, with or without food, as directed by your doctor. It can be chewed, swallowed whole, or crushed and mixed with food. For pinworm infections, this medication is typically administered as a single dose. If necessary, a second treatment may be given after a few weeks. For other common worm infections, such as roundworm or hookworm, take the medication as directed by your doctor, usually twice daily (morning and evening) for three days. A second treatment may also be required after a few weeks. For other types of infections, follow your doctor’s specific instructions. It is crucial to take this medication exactly as prescribed by your doctor. Do not skip doses, and continue taking the medication until the full prescribed amount is completed, even if symptoms resolve. Common side effects may include stomach or abdominal pain, vomiting, diarrhea, headache, dizziness, or drowsiness. Remember that this medication has been prescribed because your doctor has determined that the benefits outweigh the risks of side effects. Serious allergic reactions to this drug are rare. This is not a complete list of possible side effects. In the U.S., contact your doctor for medical advice about side effects. In Canada, consult your doctor for medical advice about side effects. Before taking this medication, inform your doctor or pharmacist if you are allergic to it or if you have any other allergies. This product may contain inactive ingredients that could cause allergic reactions or other problems. During pregnancy, this medication should only be used when clearly needed. It is known to pass into breast milk. Drug interactions may alter how your medications work or increase your risk for serious side effects. This document does not include all possible drug interactions. Keep a list of all the products you use (including prescription, non-prescription drugs, and herbal products) and share it with your doctor and pharmacist. In case of overdose, if someone has serious symptoms such as passing out or trouble breathing, call 911 immediately. Otherwise, contact a poison control center right away. U.S. residents can call 1-800-222-1222. If you are taking this medication for an extended period, laboratory and/or medical tests (such as complete blood count, liver, or kidney function tests) may be performed to monitor your progress and check for side effects. Ensure you attend all medical and laboratory appointments.
